name: Red Desert Threshold
description:
Legend has it that there was once a prince who was exiled by his father and imprisoned in this jail.
The bronze revelation first emerged here in this lonely, forgotten place where there is neither day nor night.

tabs.name: Edge of the End
tabs.description: The wise once debated wisdom in this corner of the ancient city, outlining the desert king's dream. After the bubble burst, this place became a secret holding cell for prisoners. Today, it has become a hotbed of monsters, but there are also treasures of the past to be found here.
